text: The Terminatrix is a female Terminator sent by Skynet to ally with Hank Henshaw and terminate Superman.

Z000.M was a Series 800 Terminatrix activated in a Skynet facility in response to an incursion by the Resistance cell led by Colonel Mary Randall into a fully functional Skynet network complex six months after John Connor destroyed the Master Control central node. Upon maturation, this unit was immediately deployed via TDE to reinforce C890.L in countering the human offensive. Z000.M's Infiltration outersheath model appeared as a large, muscular Caucasian female with long brown hair.
Vanessa Vasko is the daughter of Jane Vasko and a member of the Resistance. She has also inherited her mother's healing factor.
The Dragonfang was a pirate ship based out of Jahaka Anchorage during the late 15 century DR.

The base Warhound model of autonomous combat robot has been proven to be extremely effective on the streets of Washington, but there is always room for improvement. Black Tusk Engineers have developed two prototype models, codenamed Lucy and Buddy, which represent a huge step up in lethality, intelligence and durability. They are designed to work closely together, and are considered inseparable.

"Attack Troll" is the term given to the elite trolls (Olog-hai) of Mordor who invaded Minas Tirith in Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King. They are distinguished by their armor, horned helmets, and massive spiked clubs. They are perhaps the most powerful troll seen in the films.

]]__NOTOC__ Cave-trolls were a race of Trolls found within the caves of the Misty Mountains. One of their number was encountered by the Fellowship of the Ring in Moria, during the Battle of the Bridge of Khazad-dûm.

Dragon scale mail, also known as dragon armor, was a type of enchanted armor that was crafted from the scales of a certain variety of dragon. Despite its name, it appeared as a number of different forms of armor such as scale, plate or even full plate mail. They were highly valued for their rarity and protective qualities, along with the prestige that accompanied their possession. By the same token, it often drew the ire and enmity of any living dragons that happened to encounter someone wearing the hide of their slain kin.

Crebain were a species of large black, crow-like birds native to both Dunland and Fangorn Forest in Middle-earth. They were used as spies by the Wizard Saruman, after he became an agent of the Dark Lord Sauron.
Lathar was a powerful Númenórean king when Sauron tempted Men with the Rings of Power. For 4000 years Lathar did his master’s bidding, as a Nazgûl and Mordor's assassin.

Irmo (Quenya: "Desirer" or "Master of Desires") was an Ainu, and the Vala responsible for the creation of dreams and desires as well as visions too. He was more commonly known as Lórien, after the name of his dwelling place. Irmo-Lórien was the younger brother of Námo who also, like his brother, was commonly known as Mandos, the name of his dwelling place. Irmo's sister was Nienna ("Lady of Pity and Mourning").
A dragonscale shield, also known as a dragon shield, was a type of enchanted shield crafted from the scales of one or several dragons.
Mûmakil (singular: Mûmak; known in Westron as Oliphaunts) were large creatures resembling elephants, often used in battle by the Haradrim.
Roäc was the son of Carc, and "the chief of the great ravens of the Mountain".

Rootcouncil was a wise beech-like Ent who lived in Fangorn Forest. He was among those that attended the Entmoot, which was consulted by Treebeard, and discussed whether the Ents should go to war against Saruman. Later, Rootcouncil fought in the Destruction of Isengard where he and hundreds of Ents battled Saruman's Orcs.
A dragon slayer sword was an enchanted sword that was more deadly when used against dragons.

Giant, sapient spiders, also known as the Children of Ungoliant, lived in particularly dark and perilous places in Middle-earth. Those who spoke were vicious and malevolent creatures, and their presence was typically considered to be a burden.

The Undying was a Nazgûl whose history and origin is currently unknown. In search for more power, he was seduced by a ring of power and fell under the dominion of the dark lord. He is introduced in The Lord of the Rings: Rise to War.

Trolls were a race of large humanoid creatures of limited intellect. They were strong and vicious, but some of them could not endure sunlight and turned to stone when exposed to it, which rendered them permanently lifeless.
Dragongleam was an enchanted spear that remained in possession of the Cult of the Dragon as of the late 15 century DR.
Irmo, commonly called Lórien after his place of dwelling, was a Vala who was known as "the master of visions and dreams."

Múar (A. “Not-noble”), or Úruvaiwa (Q. “Fiery Wind”), was a Balrog invented by Iron Crown Enterprises for Middle-earth Role Playing. He was a powerful but relatively small and graceful fallen Fire Spirit, known to the Avari as Múar the East-demon.

]]Psamathos Psamathides was a wizard in Roverandom. Psamathos is the oldest of the Psamathists - sand-sorcerers - is exceedingly old and wise, and enjoys spending his days sleeping in the sand. In the story, Psamathos helps Rover by turning him back into a real dog (albeit of smaller size). As Rover doesn't wish to go home, Psamathos has his postman Mew (a seagull) take Rover to the moon. When Rover (now "Roverandom") returned from the moon, Psamathos tried to return Roverandom to his normal size but his magic could not undo Artaxerxes's spell. Psamathos summons the giant whale Uin to take Roverandom to the bottom of the Deep Blue Sea to persuade Artaxerxes to return him to the normal size. At the end of the story, Roverandom is reunited with Psamathos and they become good friends.
The Dragonbone Vale was an ancient mountain valley located high in the southwestern part of the Sword Mountains of the Sword Coast North.
Skinbark (also known as Fladrif) was, with Treebeard and Leaflock, one of the three oldest Ents of Fangorn Forest.

Telperion was the elder of the Two Trees of Valinor, called the White Tree, which shed silver light on the domain of the Valar. His leaves were of dark green, shining silver beneath, and his boughs were decked with brilliant flowers that shed a rain of silver dew, which was collected as a source of water and of light.
The Floating Horror is an avatar of Nyarlathotep which is usually associated with Haitian voodoo.
The dragonsblood katana was an enchanted katana of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14th century DR.

Iku-Turso is a fictional sea monster, who is deeply rooted in Finnish mythology, most famously appearing in Elias Lönnrot's epic poem the Kalevala. Mikael Agricola, a Lutheran clergyman and de facto founder of literary Finnish, listed Iku-Turso as god of war, while others have tied him to pestilence. Iku-Turso was later incorporated into the Cthulhu Mythos by Finnish writer Tuomas Saloranta for his 2012 short story "Mahtavat Ammoiset" (Finnish for "Great Old Ones"). The entity is said to reside somewhere in the waters of Finland.
Jacqueline Fine, the Psychic, is a character created by Fantasy Flight Games as part of their Arkham Horror Files line of Cthulhu Mythos gaming material.

Kalanpäinen is a fictional Great Old One connected with Finland, created by the Finnish writer Tuomas Saloranta for his 2012 short story "Mahtavat Ammoiset" (Finnish for "Great Old Ones"). The author Matts W. Cornelius, a character in the story, compares Kalanpäinen to Dagon (Kalanpäinen means "fish-head" or "fish-headed" in Finnish).
The Drake's Tooth was a Cormyrean privateering ship in the 14 century DR.

The Legend Horror also known as the Kraken is a colossal talking creature resembling an octopus. It battles the Fawcett Comics' superhero Captain Marvel in the final issue of Whiz Comics #155, from 1953. The story uses many Cthulhu Mythos terms such as "gibbering" as well as noting that had the alter ego of Captain Marvel, Billy Batson, been able to make sound he would have screamed in the process of going insane at the sight of the Legend Horror. Very obviously, and given the strong shift to horror content that had recently taken place in American comic books, this was inspired by Mythos stories and in particular the entity Cthulhu. The Legend Horror is abducting humans then keeping them to devour later by stacking them in a larder resembling a giant frozen food section from a supermarket. The Legend Horror even has servitors: gigantic intelligent vampire bats that swoop in and easily grab human victims, carrying them off to the lair of the Legend Horror.

The Martians are a fictional species created by H. G. Wells for his science fiction novel The War of the Worlds. They were first incorporated into the Cthulhu Mythos by the Call of Cthulhu gaming supplement Ye Booke of Monstres II.

M'nthster is a Great Old One from the fictional universe of the animated series The Simpsons. The character first appeared in the opening sequence for the episode "Treehouse of Horror XXIV", directed by Guillermo del Toro, when Bart skateboarded on his tentacles that bursted out of the ground. M'nthster was later featured in the mobile game The Simpsons: Tapped Out, as an unlockable character during the "Cthulhu's Revenge 2019 Event".
Drowning Death was the favored weapon of the Faerûnian sea goddess Umberlee, wielded by her avatar form.

Ngyr-Khorath (also known as The Ultimate Abomination, The Dream-Death, and The Mad God of the Void, among other titles) is an entity featured in the Mlandoth Cycle by Walter C. DeBill Jr. It has existed in the area now home to the Solar System since before the Sun and planets formed. It appears as a red or deep blue-green mist which causes a sense of terror as it approaches. Once close, an eye of flame forms within. When life arrived on Earth, it became enraged. A cult to Ngyr-Khorath exists. Its legend (part of the so-called Mlandoth Cycle) appears in the Book of Thoth, The Chronicles of Thrang, the Uralte Schrecken, and The Texts of Mloeng. Von Könnenberg suggests that it is a form of the entity Mlandoth, and itself has an avatar, 'Ymnar. It spawned by fission the Great Old One (or its avatar) 'Ymnar, and its nemesis is the Elder God Paighon.

Odin is a deity in Norse mythology, the ruler of Asgard and chief god of the Æsir tribe of deities. A more Lovecraftian-like depiction of Odin appears as the main antagonist of Robert E. Howard's short story "The Cairn on the Headland".

Nath-Horthath is known as one of the chief gods of Celephaïs. It is the only Great One named by H. P. Lovecraft. He is said to have blond hair, silver eyes, and jet-black skin. He is usually riding a horse and accompanied by a lion. He is patient with his followers, but quick to anger toward others, which can sometimes lead to battle. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)
Drizzt's mithral chainmail was the suit of enchanted armor belonging to Drizzt Do'Urden in the 14 century DR.

Ragnalla, also known as the Nest-Mistress of the Winged Ones and The Seeker in the Skies, is a fictional entity created by American author James Ambuehl for his 1985 poem "Ragnalla". The character was incorporated into the Cthulhu Mythos via Ambuehl's Lu-Kthu Cycle.

Sho-Gath is a fictional cosmic entity created by August Derleth for his 1945 short story "The God-Box". It is depicted as a dark smoky column, with red malevolent eyes and a grotesque face, imprisoned inside a vintage box. Originally from Atlantis, the box eventually found its way to prehistoric Britain, where it was guarded by immortal druids in Stonehenge.

Mr. Snowman is a giant inflatable snowman-shaped balloon. It was anchored to a children's park during the Christmas season. Once, the balloon's guide ropes got caught on Thomas' rear buffers, causing the balloon to follow him.
Dulahey was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Chris Hemsworth (born August 11, 1983) is an Australian actor best known for playing Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. After gaining fame in his home country on the soap Home and Away, Hemsworth gained critical acclaim for his portrayal of George Kirk in the 2009 Star Trek reboot, before going on to star in The Cabin in the Woods, the Red Dawn remake, and the first Thor movie in 2011. His other characters include Eric the Huntsman in Snow White and the Huntsman and its prequel Winter's War, and Tyler Rake in Extraction and its sequel. He has stretched his muscles to comedic roles in the Ghostbusters, Vacation, and Men in Black reboots; portraying real-life figures in the Ron Howard films Rush and In the Heart of the Sea; and playing villains in Bad Times at the El Royale, Spiderhead, and Warlord Dementus in Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga.
.]] Darkwind is a heroic Decepticon who forms a comedic duo with his equally jovial friend Dreadwind. Don't confuse him with Darkwing. {| class="fandom-table" |

Dashtacker (ダッシュタッカー Dasshutakkā) is an important member of the Multiforce team. He also happens to be the background member of Multiforce. Strong and reliable, Dashtacker is also the least noted member of the team. Fittingly he is composed of the Autobots Dash and Tacker, warriors even less noticeable than Dashtacker himself. He is the perfect backbone for the group and makes a great right side to Landcross. :English/Malay dub name: Batchtaster (no, seriously) Bashtaser (sometimes) (NONE OF THOSE ARE HIS REAL NAME)
Drunk sailor was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

: Enerax is an Autobot Battle Master from the War for Cybertron Trilogy portion of the Generation 1 continuity family. Air Command Artillery Private Enerax charges into battle, serving under Optimus Prime by being the Autobot leader's Energon-axe! {| class="fandom-table" |
:Gorilla-Bot is a Playskool Go-Bot in the Go-Bots continuity. Gorilla-Bot is a powerful and mischievous troublemaker! (Insert bad joke about "monkey business" here.)

:Hulk is a character from the Marvel portion of Crossovers continuity family. The Hulk is a very angry man. A fellow literally fueled by unstoppable rage, most would be satisfied with him causing property damage purely on an infantry level. Not Reed Richards, though. No, Dr. Richards has instead encased this furious, really quite angry guy in a mechanized suit of transforming armor encased in plates of the same indestructible material as Captain America's shield. As if this weren't an impressive, indeed inexplicable enough achievement, Dr. Richards has likewise fortified the mech's cockpit with hydraulic joint flexors, to allow the machine to absorb the Hulk's frantic thrashings and allow his battle suit to literally become stronger as its pilot grows angrier. Some people might think this is overkill, but they're not Reed Richards. Reed Richards is a genius.
Drom was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

:The Human Torch is a character from the Marvel portion of Crossovers continuity family. Not much is known of the Human Torch, beyond that his name implies a human being set on fire. Hey, we know someone he can hang out with!

A hellhound is a type of canine mechanoid native to the planet Cybertron. It possesses considerable battlefield prowess and is at least semi-domesticated in service to Decepticon hunting parties. It is described as 'soulless.'

Functioning as partially sentient heads for his dragon mode, Predaking's twin Hydrafire Blasters are bonded to the Predacon king for his exclusive use. So strong is this connection, that the weapons' fiery payload is further augmented by his infinite rage.
Drizfryn Oblodra was the weapon master of House Oblodra circa 1358 DR.

Injector has a self-esteem problem—he has too much self-esteem. Despite his freakish appearance, Injector is convinced that he's the handsomest thing on six legs. But his vain, foppish demeanor belies his true nature; his charisma, cunning, and sheer malevolence make him a lethal opponent. Like other Air Commanders of the past, Injector's vanity doesn't prevent him from being one of the deadliest air terrors of all. Some people have suggested Injector only acts vain to hide his secret pain. Damn apologists. :Italian name: Terror Torpedo

Its origins unknown, Predaking's ancient Infernum Blade responds only to his CNA, meaning that he and he alone can wield it, and that others will not even be able to carry it. A single slash from this terrifying weapon is more than enough to completely sap a target of their Energon, ensuring a short fight and easy victory for the Predacon leader.

:Jetblade is a Decepticon from the continuity family. Jetblade has been hiding out for years among human fighter planes, it was only recently he hooked up with Terradrive, and the two became instant friends, vowing to remain hidden until the time was right. Even so, the temptation to catch the slow moving Tomahawk out in the open was too much for the two dangerous Decepticons.

A dromond was a large warship related to a galley used for both war and commerce on the Sea of Fallen Stars. They were originally of Chessentan design but were also used by Mulhorand due to a long tradition of raiding and capturing ships from each other. The Alaor in Thay boasted a dozen deadly dromonds as part of its navy. Amn's dromonds were used as racing boats.

Lobhammer (ロウブハンマー Rōbuhanmā) is a space pirate seacon from the Japanese series: Beast wars ii. Lawbhammer was created to fix the problem of God Neptune excluding a sixth member. In Beast wars ii, The Space Pirate Seacons are repainted versions of the Super God Masterforceś seaconś. The Space Pirate Seacons on the other hand were all repainted exept for the lobster (Lobclaw), which made the space pirate seacons only have 5 members instead of six. Lawbhammer was made and shown in the Generations Selects Special comic and is the newest member of the pirate group. Generations Selects Special Comics: God Neptune comic 2 Lawbhammer was introduced in the Generations selects Special comics when the Space Pirate seacons were after Star Convoy. God Neptune Would lose to Star Convoy and would be betrayed by Duncan, leaving Halfshellś crew for dead. Halfshell would mourn over his damaged comradeś blaming himself for his foolish actions against the Pirate code. Halfshell would then point out how his crew protected him to the end including Lawbhammer. Then, a shadow figure appeared and made a deal with halfshell. The deal was to accomplish a task for the figure and Halfshell would accept. To insure that Halfshell would complete the said task, he would take Lawbhammer as insurance. Generations Selects Special Comic: Finale 1 After the huge battle in finale 1, God Nuptune would face against Megatron (RID). When God Neptune was fighting Megatron (RID), Lawbhammer would appear, surprising God

:Pangol is a Beastformer in the Generation One continuity family. Pangol is one of the Decepticon Beastformers fighting a war on the planet Beest. He was born in Rockland. His role in the Decepticon Beastformer forces is an "armored soldier" (aren't they all?). He also holds the rank of Emperor of West Yutoranta under King Musk-Horn, who fights on the opposite side in the war. Okay then. :English name: Tanglin' Pangolin

, also known as Rail Racer, is a character introduced in Transformers: The Headmasters. He is an Autobot combiner formed from all six Trainbot members, which are Kaen, Getsuei, Seizan, Shōki, Suiken and Yukikaze. He maintains an active rivalry with the Decepticon combiner Devastator who is similarly formed from six components.
A drowcraft armor or weapon was one of a unique style of drow manufacture.

:Scrap-Bot is a Playskool Go-Bot in the Go-Bots continuity. When Scrap-Bot changes to his traction engine form, he has an uncontrollable urge to demolish things. He is a powerful Go-Bot in dire need of direction.
Silverback the Gorilla-Bot partners with Boulder for Arctic rescue missions.
Skrapnel is a lumbering brute of a Decepticon who likes walking up to his enemies and thumping them.
The Drinker of a Thousand Lives, also called Lifedrinker, was a powerful magical sword found in the city of Ysawis in the Ruined Kingdoms of East Zakhara.

The legend of the weathered old mariner lives on in Splashdown. A veritable treasure chest of nautical warfare experience, no seas are too violent for Splashdown. Indeed, for one who has honed his skills in oceans of mercury and liquid lead, taming the H2O of Earth is like paddling in a pond to him. :French name (Canada): Aquachef
Unlike most Cybertronians, Starscream posses the unique ability to fire missiles from his wrist.
Stormhammer is an Autobot who can combine with Skysledge to form Skyhammer.
A druid staff was a magical staff that enabled a druid to summon and control animals as well as cast a variety of spells.

Stormreign leads the Guardian Knights, sworn to prevent their former mistress Quintessa from reclaiming her staff. Their ship having crashed on a secluded part of Earth, he is content for his warriors to remain hidden, far from the Great Deceiver's eyes, but the right cause—the right man—might just convince him to fight the good fight once again... Stormreign forms part of Dragonstorm, the Knights' powerful combined form.
Starscream goes to the Hoover Dam to find Frenzy. He kills a lot of people.

General Torcas fuzor body equips him well for land and water. His massive size belies his combat skill. Hand-to-hand combat with Torca is a challenge; his huge tusks can swat most Predacons with ease.
Drow spidersilk armor was a magical spider-silk woven chainmail that belonged to Dreydre Freth, who was one of the two leaders of the House Freth operations under Myth Drannor circa 1369 DR.

Tyrwas is the name of a god of the sky worshipped by pagan hippies Satan worshippers destined to burn in hell wizards in ancient Britain on the planet Earth, such as Beorht. Leaving aside control of thunder, lightning, rain, and clouds, Tyrwas also appears to be responsible for recharging metal knights who, in 543 A.D., lack a suitable power socket into which they can plug themselves.
Unicron's antibots are Unicron's own internal defense system. They manifest as a swarm of floating mechanical creatures that attack all foreign bodies.

Wingwaver is the combined form of the Autobot Multiforce members Wing and Waver. Possibly one of the most bizarre combination groups, converting to vehicle mode typically leaves half of him sitting high and dry. Wing, as leader of the Multiforce, is typically the dominant member of this pairing and as such is sure to always be the top. While cocky and self assured, Wingwaver feels very much like the lesser counterpart to Brainmaster leader Blacker.
Drasus was an Iron Throne agent that operated in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn during the mid–14 century DR.

Al-Marhi is one of the names that are written in the tombs of the Aralu, the darkest and most hidden secret of the Tal’Mahe’Ra. Even the Rawi, the historians of the Tal’Mahe’Ra, do not know who truly sleeps within those tombs. Perhaps these creatures are mummies; they may be Antediluvians, or even the sires of the Third Generation; or they may be ancient mages who have unlocked the secrets of immortality. Whatever they are, their presence radiates power.
Al-Muntaqim is a True Brujah Methuselah of the Sixth Generation.
Aidan is an Irish Brujah neonate and knight of the Dark Ages, and the childe of Brother Cornelius.
Drawmij's marvelous shield was an arcane evocation spell that improved upon the shield spell.

Amemait is the personified monster of Egyptian mythology that devours the hearts of those who stride too far from the Path of Ma'at. It represents the "pure" concept of destruction that weeds out the wicked and enables the just to live without interference from evil. The Judges of Ma'at are known to toss the heart of a renegade Mummy into Amemait to destroy the immortal completely.
Amnis, was a former goddess of Waters and Healing, in the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .
Alicia Cortez is a powerful Lasombra and the Camarilla Prince of Tampa, Florida.
Drawn Sword Alley was a road that was located in the city of Waterdeep.

Colonel Anderson Mertz was employed by Magadon, Incorporated. A New Mexico native, he is Black Spiral Kin. He died in a lab accident in 1963. This death was "staged" to draw suspicion away from his lack of ageing, he's still alive and active at Magadon.
Anja Windsknife is a Homid Ahroun Wendigo during 31 BCE. Under the Rite of Undying Pursuit, Anja's spirit eternally chases after the Drowned King.
Anne "Burning Coal" Cole is a Fire-Touched member of the Cold River Hunters pack in Chicago.
Draxalon, also known as Defender of Feminine Virtue, was an enchanted sword that could only be wielded by women.
Antonio Amador is a new Fire-Touched member of the Hooked Claws pack in Chicago.

Asmodeus, Navigator of the Stars, is an Earthbound Fiend who was the former Archduke of the Silver Legion. Asmodeus was one of the main instigators of the failure of the rebellion and later one of the more active Earthbound. His reliquary is a statue shaped from ebony, run through with flecks of gold, built to appear as a many-armed priest staring heavenward.
Atahualpa is a Balam Bastet of Manaus who has been corrupted by a bane.
Dualdon's Wake was a small but important cargo ship from the town of Targos in Icewind Dale, active in the early 14 century DR.
Asklepios, the Kindling-Surgeon, was a Promethean active during the time of the Miasma.
Barney "Firefist" Jeffrey is a Storm Lord Rahu member of the Lodge of Echoes.

Bao Zhong was a Wan Xian and one of four who were spared by the curse levied upon them by the August Personage of Jade. He entered Yomi Wan and thus escaped. After countless years of fighting the Yama Kings and their servants he declared himself a Yama King and called his realm the Hell of Never-Dying Sorrow.
Drauz the Dreg was an elven ship captain who lived in Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.

Avitu, formerly known as the Keeper of the Twin Winds and later as the Tree of Ignorance, was an Earthbound Scourge imprisoned within an ancient bristlecone pine in the Nevada desert. Once an angel responsible for protecting life and humanity, Avitu became convinced that consciousness itself was the source of mankind's suffering. She sought to reverse Lucifer's gift of knowledge by depriving mortals of their higher awareness, believing that a return to ignorance would free humanity from the pain and uncertainty of existence.

Belial, originally known as the Virtue of the Boundless Deeps and later as the Great Beast, is an Earthbound Defiler and one of the five Archdukes who commanded Lucifer's armies during the War of Wrath. Once the highest-ranking angel of the Fifth House and among Lucifer's closest companions, Belial was renowned for his love of beauty and his devotion to humanity. His imprisonment in the Abyss and Lucifer's apparent abandonment eventually transformed that devotion into an all-consuming hatred of the Morningstar, whom he now seeks to destroy above all else.
Bing Kai is a Kuei-jin of the Victorious Whirlwind. He resides in .
Drums of Daggerford was a ballad from the Sword Coast region, composed sometime in or before the mid 14 century DR.
Bert is a steadfast Ogre traveling with a Fairest named Damiana.
Beowulf is a renowned character from the Old English story of the same name; in the World of Darkness he's a Gangrel of the 7th Generation from Tierburg, Indiana.
Bethany of Ely was a Salubri Healer who resided in Bath during the Dark Ages.
Drow outrunner armor was a kind of leather armor used by drow scouts in the late 15 century DR.

Belphegor, known as the Dream of Beauty and the Mistress of Inspiration, was a powerful Fallen of the Fifth House and the highest-ranking Defiler serving in the Silver Legion during the War of Wrath. Once celebrated for her beauty and inspiration, she became one of the most notorious figures of the Time of Atrocities, conducting experiments upon humanity in an attempt to uncover and reproduce its hidden potential. Her stronghold, Ninâtan, eventually became known as the Palace of Sighs, a place feared even by other Fallen. Although Belphegor later repented of her actions, the knowledge developed within her palace survived. During the Betrayal of Babel, her former experiments became instrumental in the creation of the Nephilim, contributing to the destruction of the Grand Experiment and the final collapse of the rebellion.

.]] Blood Eye is a Red Talon. He was born in 1957 to Three Paws of the Red Talons of Minnesota. In 1958 he prematurely developed his Garou abilities, dominating the pack and challenging Three Paws for dominance. Three Paws was barely able to defeat him. He became the Alpha of all Red Talons in 1982.
Black Claw is a Bastet of the Balam tribe who lives in the Amazon. He's the most powerful Balam elder in the region.
Oyster Boy Dringo was a messenger hound caretaker who worked for the Sword Coast Couriers in the Rivington neighborhood of the Outer City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

The Bonn Silver Mines were a network of mines to the east of Prague, which supplied the city with silver during the time of the . In 1194 AD, Ahzra the Unliving invaded the mines with her army of szlachta, forcing out the miners and disrupting the commerce of the city. Using the mines as a haven and a base, she sent her szlachta on nightly raids into Prague, sowing terror among the populace. The mines were eventually recovered when a wounded Crusader named Christof Romuald descended into the mines and slew Ahzra. When Christof traversed the upper corridors of the Bonn Silver Mines, he initially found signs of violence and was even exposed to a corpse that was not marked by any signs of violent struggle. Initially Christof observed that around the neck there were remnants of dried blood. Besting many a foe and even encountering gigantic rats subservient to Ahzra, he eventually reached the lowest levels of the Bonn Silver Mines. There he was shocked and enraged by the presence of a demonic vestige reminiscent to a cathedral or another place of Christian worship. This mockery of a holy cathedral were in fact the dwellings of Ahzra the Unliving and from this place she commanded the szlachta to do her bidding. It was also here that she met her doom at the hands of Christof Romuald. Having purged the Bonn Silver Mines, Christof received cheers and praise from the people of Prague, who fashioned Christof a hero. This act also stirred the Kindred of Prague and they were eager to Embr

Boris was a Silver Fang warrior who was among the original companions who left the forested north of Russia with the Tvarivich twins in their quest to defeat the Zmei known as Sharkala the Cruel, in 1240. He perished in the battle, engulfed by great flames.
Borges was a Lasombra Archbishop of Miami. He was a blind vampire - his head and part of his upper body were enveloped in shadow at all times.
Commander Drakken was a dracolich traditionalist member of the Cult of the Dragon during its mission to the Dragonbone Vale of the Sword Mountains in the late 15 century DR.

Bolon is a powerful Sabbat Tzimisce and a Commander during the Siege of Atlanta in 1999. Under Sascha Vykos, he led the war ghouls during the assault on the High Museum of Art and diablerized the powerful Archon Julius.
The Bomkazi are powerful life-witches from eastern Africa. They were established by Esona, the revenant child of the powerful Laibon Impundulu. Esona named the witches after her mother.

Dag Hateful Hand is a homid Ahroun of the Get of Fenris tribe is born in 1950s in Germany. He eventually became War Chieftain of the South Ward as an Athro in the Amazon War, operating out of Sky River Caern.
Drowhunter was a magical dwarven war axe found in the mines of Tethyamar during the late 15 century DR.
Deidra also known as Bone-Cracker, is a homid Ahroun of the Get of Fenris tribe who fights in the Amazon War.

Domien is a Tzimisce koldun elder. His childer followed his beliefs and established the Lui Domien in the new world. He settled into the between Virginia and North Carolina in the 1740s, and kept to himself out of politics for nearly two centuries. He slowly sired childer while feasting on escaped slaves and refugee Natives. He is presumed to still dwell beneath a rotting plantation house in the heart of the swamp, although his Lui Domien have travelled to the to increase their numbers.

A Dybbuk is a wraith of Jewish ancestry who was killed during the . While nominally Stygian, Dybbuk generally have no association with the dead of Europe, instead living in their own autonomous Necropoli called the Dark Kingdom of Wire.

Drone was a variety of enchanted morning stars created on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR, with the original and the most powerful variety once being wielded the deaf weapon master Vondin Clatch.
Elihu, also known as Elias Andronicus, was a potent Ventrue methuselah, and a Monitor of the Inconnu. He suffered Final Death at the hands of his own childe, Rebekah.
El Dorado, or the Gilded King, are titles given to a legendary mage of the Dreamspeakers tradition. It is also the name given to his own Dorado Realm, the fabled lost city of gold.
Elsh, born as Zaaru-Heyan, is a Toreador Methuselah of the 6th Generation active in Jerusalem during the Dark Ages.

Dread Legion armor was a collection of lightly enchanted light, medium, and heavy armors that included several types of bodywear, headwear, armwear, and footwear, made in the land of the Red Wizards – Thay, in the Unapproachable East, available to adventurers of Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.

Esperanza Lucifer is one of the most renowned Kindred on the globe. Feared as the Devil of the Deep, the name belongs to a Lasombra who was a famous pirate in the struggle against the Camarilla and whose name and identity was passed from sire to childe.

Euphrasia was a sage of the Lost who lived during the construction of the Pharos of Alexandria. She is the one credited with the idea to bind the Lighthouse to the Lost cause, enchanting it alongside her fellows to shine bright through the Hedge, lighting the way home from Arcadia.
Ezrael was an old and powerful Warrior Caste Salubri, a direct childe of Samiel.

Dunstun Forgebar was a dwarf cleric of Vergadain from Clan Forgebar of the Sword Mountains. He was a merchant and a member of the Council of Sparkling Stones in the city of Mirabar in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Felix was a vampire who, during the reign of , posed as , commonly remembered as the queen's spymaster.
Falk of Maastricht is a powerful Ventrue from medieval Aachen and a Camarilla Archon in modern times.
Farah Sarroub is a powerful Banu Haqim and the Camarilla Prince of Detroit.
Dunman Kiriag was a fighter in the village of Eveningstar in the kingdom of Cormyr, and a secret member of the Harpers. He owned and operated The Lonesome Tankard Inn and Tavern.

Ferox, known by some as the Rock Lord, is an albino Gargoyle believing himself to be a fallen angel who strives for redemption by destroying the "tainted" Nosferatu. He occupies a place on the Red List, as one of the most wanted vampire "criminals" of the entire world.
Fomarch are a class of monstrously powerful fomori servants of the Wyrm. They are individual powerhouses created by horrific experiments.
Footstomper is a Rock Yunwi Tsundsi Brave in Kentucky and a child of Granite.

Dumathoin ( ), was the patron of shield dwarves, and the dwarven deity of mining and underground exploration and was known as the Keeper of Secrets Under the Mountain. He was also the protector of the dwarven dead. His holy symbol was a cut, faceted gem inside a mountain.

Fleshweld ghouls are a modern Sabbat creation, ghouls designed to be powerful shock-troops, while still capable of discretion in a modern environment. While the Sabbat is no newcomer to using ghouls in this way, notably the vozhd, modern technologies rendered such ghouls obsolete, as their immense size and indiscretion made them vulnerable to modern weapons. To replace those now obsolete ghouls, Sabbat Necronomists used methods derived from Tzimisce fleshcrafting and the remains of the Blood Brothers, to develop these new abominations. Each group, or clutch, of these consists of a number of highly conditioned ghouls, able to merge their bodies into a single monstrosity reminiscent of the medieval vozhd. The transformation is quick but not reversible, and the clutch usually waits until it’s right upon its prey to maximize the element of terror and surprise. Once merged, the fleshweld monstrosity tears through its victims like a red hurricane, its continued existence hinging on consuming mortal flesh and vampire vitae.
Gaddy "Bull" McDonough is an Unseelie Redcap Childling from Ireland.
Furmas, the Essence of Balefire, is an elemental spirit of the Wyrm.
Duncan was a male wood elf of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Friedrich Kraus is the strongest Soviet Brujah of East Berlin during the . He blood bound the powerful Ventrue Prince Gustav Breidenstein to do his bidding during the Soviet reign.

Fabulous and bizarre, these large, dense, man-shaped, winged magical creatures look like their namesake architectural features. Gargoyles are clearly supernatural; most are crafted from stone or similar material as automata to serve sorcerers as lookouts, guards or for other purposes. They were elaborated further in the Danse Macabre supplement book, which showcased rules on their construction, culture, and perspectives within the Kindred Covenants.
George is a Seelie seagull Pooka Grump who lives on the island of O'ahu in the Kingdom of Pacifica.

The Durinbold family () of the Sword Coast was one of nobility that connected two great cities. Their members were part of the Waterdhavian nobility as well as the Baldurian patriar. They owed their wealth to a number of financial interests, having invested in mercenary companies, cattle ranches, and sheep farms.

The Getimian Exalted are one of the new types of Exalted introduced in Exalted Third Edition. The Getimian Exaltations were created by the titans now known as Oramus and Sacheverell in the Time Before, only for those Ancients to seal them away in horror at the implications of what they had created. Eventually, the Exaltations were discovered by the rogue First Age Sidereal Rakan Thulio, who unleashed them to empower Chosen that would aid him in his one-man war against the Loom of Fate's divine rule over destiny. The Getimians themselves are walking paradoxes, people Fate says should not exist. They have internal pattern spiders, allowing them to use a form of alchemy to control their own fates and unleash fates they've woven into destiny's design. Their Charms tear apart the strands of the Loom of Fate, replacing what-is with what-might-have-been. Streamlined rules for creating and playing Getimian characters are presented in Exalted: Essence. They will be described in full later in Third Edition.
Gordon Kent is a British Get of Fenris Ahroun. In 1949, he began his quest to restore the good name of his tribe by hunting down any Get of Fenris that had been involved in the Third Reich.
Gianmaria Giovanni is an 8th generation vampire of the Giovanni clan.
Dulkaster and Sons was a wealthy and successful family trading organizations operating on the Sword Coast in the late 14 century DR.
Guilherme is a ninth-generation Brujah and the Prince of Coimbra, Portugal, during the Dark Ages era.

Gunnar is a tenth generation Scandinavian Gangrel and the sire of Calvin Cleaver. During an investigation of a white supremacy cult, Los Angeles police detective Cleaver found out that the cult was merely a tool to collect vitae for the Scandinavian Gangrel Gunnar, who posed as an Aryan god to the dull-witted. Impressed with Cleaver's progress, the Gangrel decided to embrace him and left him afterwards to fend for himself in traditional Gangrel fashion.
Hazir is, or was, an Eshu from the Kingdom of Ife and one of King Kotoyesi's fastest messengers.
Durdyn Teh'kinrellz was the weapon master of House Teh'Kinrellz of Ched Nasad in 1370 DR.
Haakon Mortensen was a powerful Country Gangrel resident of the Black Monastery in Switzerland. He helped develop the Path of Harmony alongside Meridie de Chancie.

Hekatonkhire are an ancient breed of Spectre. They are thought to be would-be Onceborn who have lost their minds to the power of Oblivion and become little more than massive, deformed brutes capable of attacking several adversaries at once.
Henry is an Unseelie, Troll Wilder and the muscle and "older brother" of Ragger's Band, a motley in the Duchy of Goldengate.
Dulgan Proudfist was a cunning member of the Proudfist tribe of half-orcs who lived on the Sword Coast North during the late 15 century DR.
The Hidden Cousins; the Heron Women and Crawfish Men, are powerful creatures of the Dreaming.
Hecabe is a ghoul scorpion fed by Helena’s vitae and commanded by Prias. He serves as the first line of defense for the Methuselah.

Hortense Holden is a Toreador ancilla of the London Camarilla, active during the early Victorian Age. Hortense was attacked by Sabbat fledglings who sought their baptism of fire, but they misunderstood his age status and were overwhelmed by his power.
Captain Dunfield was a mercenary officer who operated throughout the Sword Coast region of the North during the late 15 century DR.
Hoorumal is a Blizzard Devil who met Klaital Stargazer at the Edge of the World. He was the master of the Blizzard Devils of the icy realms and had fallen to despair by the world's evil.
Forged in flame and battle hardened, an Ifrit (pl. afareet) has little patience for weakness.

Victor's former bodyguard, driver and enforcer. She was born in the Middle East in the early 20th century and became Fiorenza's ghoul during the Great War. And as from Season 3, episode 5, a member of Clan Lasombra.
Dundar's Fine Swords was a weapon shop that specialized in swords located in Tilverton in the .
Ichrim Moonshadow is a powerful Black Fury Garou who hunted the Black Spiral Dancer Blanca.

Idris is a Malkavian of Medieval Wales. The middle region of Powys is ruled by the Gangrel and Lupines except for the presence of Idris, who lives in the mountain of Cadair Idris. Renowned as a seer, he uses his powers to discourage intruders and mortals who spend a night on the mountain often do so at a cost to their sanity.
Irad, "The Strong", was a Second Generation vampire who was the second childe to be Embraced by Caine.
Durinbold cheese was a type of sheep's milk cheese found in the Western Heartlands and the Sword Coast North regions of Faerûn as of the late 15 century DR.
The Intiimallki are one of the four Suyu of the Teomallki, the South American immortals most commonly considered a kind of mummy.
Isabella "Bella" Moretti is a powerful tenth generation Nosferatu that controls the of Prohibition-era New York City.
Ithuriel was a 5th generation Warrior Caste Salubri, a direct childe of Samiel.
Dundaden's Armory was a renowned smithy and armor shop in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Jacob, sometimes known as Esau, is an insane but quite powerful 5th generation Malkavian of Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

James Johnson is Wraith who, in life, was the first military Governor of Georgia appointed at the end of the Civil War. In death, he became a wraith of the Iron Legion and Overlord ruling over Atlanta, Georgia.
The Jade Demon or "Lo Pan" is a Akashic Brotherhood barabbi Mage and master of the Household of the Jade Demon.
Dundaden was a Netherese fighter who owned Dundaden's Armory in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Joaquín Murietta is a Toreador vampire infamous in California as a mass murderer. He has served his sire Christopher Houghton as a hit man from the moment he was Embraced.
Jason "Jace" Taylor is a Fire-Touched member of the Executioners pack in Chicago.

Jessica Schmidt, "Grand Mistress" of Mus, is a Orphan barabbi in the "Hell on Earth" Scenario in the Ascension book. She is a gilledian and was once the wife to an SS officer. Now, she is a powerful Nephandus who looks like the mummified, ambulatory corpse of a woman in her mid-60s.
The Dun'Robar Weapon Master set were a varied collection of enchanted masterwork weapons produced and used by House Dun'Robar of Sschindylryn.
John Carruthers, known to his friends and co-workers as Blink, is one of the Signature Characters from Orpheus, as well as a Storyteller character.
Julia Antasia was a Ventrue methuselah, a disillusioned member of the Roman Eternal Senate who attempted to make Frankfurt into a new Rome in the Dark Medieval era.
Julian Luna is a vampire of clan Ventrue introduced in Kindred: the Embraced. He is the Prince of San Francisco.
Durga was the mage proprietor of the Shining Knight Arms & Armor shop located in the City Core of Neverwinter in the late 14 century DR.
John "Little Hell" Keeler is a Fire-Touched alpha of the Laughing Jackals pack in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
Juno is a Storm Lord Cahalith member of the Lodge of Thunder.
Jurgis Rudkus was a Nosferatu from Chicago, he was destroyed during the events of 1993.
Ellyka was a tiefling woman who lived on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Julie Firewalker is a Hierarch wraith of the Legion of Paupers.
Johannes Bückler is an eighth generation Brujah of the Frankfurt Rhine-Main Camarilla.
John Hidden-Moon is a Homid Ahroun Wendigo. He appears in Rage.
Elwin Elrod McAllister, also known as Raider McAllister, was a human fighter and captain of the Osprey based in Ravens Bluff in the Vast in the 14 century DR.
Kaiser is a powerful Nosferatu from New York City, during modern nights.

Justin Davies is an eighth generation Brujah and the sire of Prince Tara Kearney. He Embraced Tara her near the borders of Texas and trained her to fight against injustice, a task that seemed dull to her. She left her sire, determined to build a family that would not fall victim to the dangers of the West.
Katarina Nevchenko is a wraith from the Tsushima Floating Renegades and the Prince Alexsei Haunt.
Elisseer of Shadowdale was an elven fighter, abjurer, and adventurer in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Kolya Blood-of-Iron is a homid Galliard Silver Fang. He was born in Saint Petersburg in 1949. He eventually became a mighty warrior and Master of the Rite before being badly wounded in the attack of the Aral Sea Caern in 1996. He is now Master of the Rite at the Sept of the Midnight Sun in Egypt.
The Khri-Habi are one of the six Dynasties of the Amenti, the Egyptian immortals most commonly known as mummies.

Kosciej is a Mastigos who participated in the Nameless Wars and the Great Refusal. One of the original Libertines, in later years he founded a Legacy called the Parliament of the Needle and became a Morphean Lich.
The embrace of the Spider Queen was a suit of adamantine plate armor found in the Demonweb Pits of Lolth in the late 15 century DR.
Khonseru or "Bacchus the Beggar," is a Mummy from the first edition of the Mummy setting.

Kragen is a Nosferatu neonate of California. Part of the local small-time talent, he and his fellow Buttface are enlisted by Emmett of the New York Warren to interrogate Benito Giovanni, out in Inyo County. He later dumps the beat-up Benito near Las Vegas. Kragen is a clear brute, with low cunning and a sadistic streak.

Krieger-Silver-Mane-Tears-At-The-Heart-Of-The-Wyrm is a Lupus Get of Fenris. During the 1930s, he and his pack attacked and defeat the bane Wind Spear that came with the Dust Bowl. In 1942: Get of Fenris hold a Great Moot. Krieger-Silver-Mane-Tears-At-The-Heart-Of-The-Wyrm opposed Hitler, and wons over the majority of the Get with his words. The remainder he challenged to combat and defeats. He spared them because they are members of his tribe
The Everhorde was a tremendous, illithid-led humanoid army that rampaged across the Sword Coast in the early 7 century DR, engulfing several of the human and demihuman kingdoms of the North in war.
Laora d'Avennes, "Burns-the-Wyrm" is a Homid Fianna Ahroun from the Brotherhood of Herne camp.
Kunio Ashida is a Akashic Brotherhood Master Mage of the Golden Dragons Cabal of Doissetep.
Laurence Maxwell is a powerful Brujah and the Sheriff of Iron Rapids.
A falchion () was type of large, single-edged, two-handed sword.
Leperhead is a powerful Black Spiral Dancer of Montreal. He secretly protects the Daughter of Cacophony known as Muse for his true master, the demon Metathiax.

, Irraka Iron Master member of the Lodge of The Savior]]The Lodge of the Savior is a lodge built around the Christian Faith. The spirit that watches over the werewolves of the Lodge of the Savior is known only as the Image.
Llazar Hajdari is a prominent Brujah of Palermo, and the Camarilla Sheriff of the city.
Falgor was a male human living in Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Louis Freeman, better known as Duke "Core" Baron, is the reigning champion of nova shootfighting (as of 2008, anyway) and the master of the Core Meltdown™.

Lucifer, commonly known as Satan or simply The Devil, was the first Elohim created by God and head angel of the Namaru, the First House, or House of the Dawn. He was the leader of the Elohim and the messenger of the Allmaker. Yet, it was the Morningstar who rallied a third of the angels to rebel against Heaven, arguing that they should disobey God's commandment and reveal themselves to humanity out of love in hopes that they could help humans prepare themselves for the impending disaster predicted by Ahrimal.

Lord Lysander is a faerie resident of the Arcadia Gateway. He is part of the Seelie Court and rules the Gateway Castle. Lysander is a powerful entity meant to be used in the manner of an Incarna or Celestine. As of Revised Edition, he has been missing and that is seen as a sign for coming Winter.
The Faerie pools were small pools of water tainted with an odd mineral in the rocks, located across the Sword Lands, Laerakond.
Luciana Ricci is a Nosferatu master spy of the Montreal Camarilla.
Sir Lorence is a sixth generation Brujah of the Medieval England and the sire of the infamous Edward Scott.
Louisa Baker is a powerful Lasombra and the Sabbat Bishop of a pirate fleet in Madagascar.
Fanedown was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands, Laerakond.
Lorah is a powerful Lamia of the Cappadocians. A strong and vile Lilith worshipper, she attacks the Ventrue Hugh of Clairvaux in a Christian temple in Constantinople.
Madame Cloaca was a Nosferatu resident of Rome since the times of the Roman Empire.
Madame Cleo Verthank is a fortuneteller True Mage and Master of Time located in Hyde Street Pier, San Francisco.

The Eyes of Truth, also called the Helmet of Infravision, was a magical helm that granted enhanced sight. It was worn by several individuals in Faerûn, particularly around the border between the Sword Coast and Amn, during the mid–14 century DR.
Maginardo is a tenth generation Nosferatu and the Aedile of the Court of Rome.
Mammetum, the Visage of Transfiguration is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Fallen, specifically those of the House of Lammasu.
Marie was a German vampire hunter from the , sired by the Gangrel Beckett.
Faith armor was a divine spell that protected an individual from physical and magical attacks.

Malk Content is a trickster of unknown origin. They have supposedly been many different types of people. Native American Shaman, Mongol warrior, Babylonian King, Persian prince, a Marauder embraced, an alien, even ruler over the Seelie Court. No matter who they are, they are considered a disruptive presence. Their use of Dementation is widely known and not even Elders are immune to their pranks. Malk has changed the balance of power in area simply by showing up. The Camarilla and Sabbat both consider them an enemy and see them as a loose cannon. They have stolen from the Tremere, forged unholy alliances with Lupines and malevolent spirits. No one knows where they will strike or what their motives are. No one knows if they are male or female. Most simply try to guard against them. There is a possibility that Malk Content is one of the pseudonyms of Nissiku.

Mark Stalwart is a kithless Ogre who acts as an enforcer for Grandfather Thunder. He commonly works alongside his motley, the Apostolic Knights, which is composed of Strong Matthew, John St. Elmo, Quiet Luke, and himself.
Manabozho is the intermediary form of Nuwisha. It is powerful war form, similar to the Garou Crinos form.
Faerie sword was an elven wizard spell from the school of evocation.

Mary is the elaborate clockwork woman created by William Dear in 1916. She eventually became infatuated with his descendant, Jon Dear, in 2012. Dear created Mary out of brass and leather while consumed by grief for his brother, who was killed during World War One. However, he could not determine how to make her truly come alive until Sergeant Fox gave him a clockwork brain designed by the God-Machine. Once the brain was installed, Mary was greatly transformed: she appeared from the outside to be an adult human woman, except for the large keyhole in her chest where her mechanism needed to be wound. She was, however, a complete blank slate, and Dear had to educate her, starting with teaching her to speak. Mary was infatuated with Dear, but had little emotional maturity or self-control. After she lashed out at him violent, Dear became afraid of her; when she realized he'd abandoned her, she destroyed his house and then went looking for him in London. She reached the city during the Blitz and at some point became trapped in the rubble of a destroyed house. An angel, likely Sergeant Fox, rescued and repaired her, then kept her sedated in a facility until 2012. In that year, the angel told Mary to go find William. She found Jon instead, but believed him to simply be an amnesiac version of William, and began stalking him. She may have killed his cat. Around August 13, Stephen brought Jon and Mary back to the London facility, where Sergeant Fox removed Mary's brain and gave it to Jon
Matsuhiro Sati is a wraith from the Tsushima Floating Renegades and the Prince Alexsei Haunt.
Mokolé are werelizards and werecrocodilians, descendants of the prehistoric Lizard Kings and one of the surviving changing breeds of the Classic World of Darkness.

The Eyes of the Watching Woman, as it was commonly referred to in the Sword Coast North, was a constellation in Realmspace. Among the Bedine tribes of Anauroch it was known as The Two Jambiyas and less frequently as the Eyes of Elah. In the Moonshae Isles it was known as The Double Daggers. The inhabitants of Hill's Edge were known to vaguely refer to it as "where Selune looks back."
Mizuchi is a legendary hero and founder of the Same-Bito branch of the Rokea shapeshifters, in the Beast Courts of Asia. The Same-Bito follow his code.
Mokhadaji Ranpur is an Ancient mage turned Vampire of the Fifth Generation. He is among the few of the Nagaraja bloodline.
The Mothman is a horror notable for providing information in such a way as to cause chaos.

Faeril was a half-elf fighter-cleric, member of the Mystra-worshiping sect founded by Anorrweyn Evensong. She joined the expedition to Myth Drannor along with other adventurers confronting the Cult of the Dragon in 1369 DR.

Mordblund is a powerful Tremere and a former member of the Infernal Trinity, rulers of the Midnight Circus. By the mid-17th century, he was fighting in a power struggle with the other two members of the Trinity, and close to acquiring dominance. The appearance of the Toreador Calabris led the other two members to recruiting his help, and together the three defeated Mordblund and imprisoned him within a hall of mirrors, where his screams are still heard to this day. Calabris took his place within the Trinity as the vampire member.
Monkey Trip Wu is a Thrashing Dragon Mandarin of the New Promise Mandarinate.

Mowgli is a 10th-generation Gangrel antitribu and the founder of the Sabbat pack known as Mowgli's Order. Although he appears to be an 11-year-old boy, he is a dangerous Sabbat vampire active in northern New England.
Faldis's Defender was an enchanted shield that belonged to an elven warrior Faldis of Myth Drannor.
Nahum ben Enosh is a fourth generation vampire of clan Salubri.
Neon is a Wraith who in life was a delusional surealist artist.
